environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB with an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint. Traffic shaping is handled by an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) injected via AWS App Mesh with a local rate limit filter configured at the virtual node level: max 2 requests per 30-second window per source IP on paths matching '/api/webhook/*'. The Envoy filter returns 429 with 'x-ratelimit-remaining: 0' header after the second request in any sliding window. The IMDS endpoint (169.254.169.254) is unreachable from Fargate tasks by default (no instance metadata service available in Fargate networking mode). Additionally, the task's security group allows egress only to port 443 on the public internet and to a specific VPC endpoint for DynamoDB (pl-xxxxxxxx). The Envoy sidecar intercepts all outbound connections from the application container via iptables REDIRECT rules on the task network namespace.

config.envoy_egress_interception: iptables REDIRECT uid-match on app container
